options.name: type
options.description: Clock format. `auto` picks 12h or 24h from the browser locale when the picker is created or its options are set.

options.name: incrementHours
options.description: Step between selectable hours on the clock, the wheel and the hour field's arrow keys. Use a divisor of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6.

options.name: incrementMinutes
options.description: Set increment for minutes (1, 5, 10, 15, etc.)

options.name: autoSwitchToMinutes
options.description: Automatically switch to minutes after selecting hour

options.name: showSeconds
options.description: Show a seconds field, wheel column and clock face (HH:MM:SS)

options.name: incrementSeconds
options.description: Set increment for seconds: 1, 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30

options.name: autoSwitchToSeconds
options.description:
Automatically switch from minutes to seconds after a minute is picked on the clock.
Only used with `showSeconds`.

options.name: smoothHourSnap
options.description: Enable smooth hour snapping with animation

options.name: discreteHourJump
options.description: Move the hour hand from hour to hour while dragging instead of following the pointer.

options.name: disabledTime
options.description: Disable specific hours/minutes/seconds or time ranges

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: Seconds (0-59) disabled in every minute. Used with `showSeconds`.

fields.name: ranges
fields.description:
Inclusive ranges. Edges: 'HH:MM' or 'HH:MM:SS' (24h), 'H:MM[:SS] AM|PM' (12h).
An edge without seconds covers its whole minute.
When set, the `hours`, `minutes` and `seconds` lists are ignored.

fields.name: interval
fields.description:
Inclusive ranges. Edges: 'HH:MM' or 'HH:MM:SS' (24h), 'H:MM[:SS] AM|PM' (12h).
An edge without seconds covers its whole minute.
When set, the `hours`, `minutes` and `seconds` lists are ignored.

options.name: isTimeDisabled
options.description:
Return `true` to disable a time. Combined with `disabledTime` as a union: a time is
disabled when either says so. `hour` is 0-23 in both clock types; `seconds` is 0 unless
`showSeconds` is on. An hour or minute is disabled when every time inside it is disabled.
Results are cached; call `refreshDisabledTime()` after the data behind the function changes.
If the function throws, that time counts as enabled and the error is rethrown asynchronously.

options.name: defaultTime
options.description:
Time the picker shows while the input is empty. `'now'` shows the current time and also writes it to the input when the picker is created, replacing a value that is already there.
Use the object form to choose: `time` is a `Date` or `'now'`, and `updateInput: true` writes it to the input the same way.
options.example:
defaultTime: 'now'
defaultTime: { time: new Date(2026, 0, 1, 9, 30), updateInput: false }

options.name: currentTime
options.description: Set current time to the input and timepicker

fields.name: locales
fields.deprecated: Has no effect since 4.5.0; the value is formatted by the library. Removed in 5.0.

options.name: mode
options.description: Picker mode: analog clock face, scroll wheel spinner, or compact wheel (no header)

options.name: theme
options.description: Theme for the timepicker

options.name: animation
options.description: Enable/disable animations

options.name: backdrop
options.description: Show backdrop when timepicker is open

options.name: initialView
options.description: View shown when the picker opens: the clock face or the keyboard fields.

options.name: mobile
options.description: Force mobile mode

options.name: viewSwitch
options.description: Show the button that switches between the clock face and the keyboard fields.

options.name: enableSwitchIcon
options.description: Enable switch icon (mobile ↔ desktop)

options.name: editable
options.description: Allow editing hour/minutes directly

options.name: allowPageScroll
options.description:
Let the page scroll while the picker is open. When false, page scroll is locked on `<html>`
(and on `<body>` when it is the scroll container), and `<html>` gets `--tp-scrollbar-gap` set to the removed
scrollbar width for your own fixed or sticky elements, e.g. `header { padding-right: var(--tp-scrollbar-gap, 0px) }`.

options.name: enableScrollbar
options.description:
Enable scrollbar when timepicker is open.
When false, page scroll is locked on `<html>` (and on `<body>` when it is the scroll container),
and `<html>` gets `--tp-scrollbar-gap` set to the removed scrollbar width for your own fixed or
sticky elements, e.g. `header { padding-right: var(--tp-scrollbar-gap, 0px) }`.

options.name: cssClass
options.description: Additional CSS class for the wrapper

options.name: clearButton
options.description: Show the Clear button. The object form also sets what Clear does: `clearInput: false` keeps the input value.

options.name: appendTo
options.description: Element, or selector of the element, the modal is appended to.

options.name: appendModalSelector
options.description: Selector where to append modal (default: body)

options.name: keyboardIcon
options.description: HTML of the keyboard icon, shown on the clock face view.

options.name: iconTemplate
options.description: Custom keyboard icon template (desktop → mobile)

options.name: clockIcon
options.description: HTML of the clock icon, shown on the keyboard view.

options.name: iconTemplateMobile
options.description: Custom schedule icon template (mobile → desktop)

options.name: inline
options.description: Inline mode configuration

fields.name: container
fields.description: Element, or selector of the element, the inline picker renders into. Required when `enabled` is true.

fields.name: showButtons
fields.description: Show the OK and Cancel buttons. OK writes the time to the input and Cancel brings back the time from the input; the picker stays visible either way.

fields.name: embedded
fields.description:
Render the inline picker as part of a host component instead of a standalone card:
the root gets `role="group"` with an accessible name (no `role="dialog"`, no `aria-modal`), the card
has no shadow and no minimum height, focus is not trapped and the wrapper does not take focus on
mount. Use it when the picker sits inside your own dialog, popover or form.
Ignored unless `enabled` is true.

options.description: Return focus to the input when the picker closes (WAI-ARIA dialog pattern). Setting it to `true` is recommended; 5.0 makes `true` the default.

options.name: focusInputAfterClose
options.description: Focus input after closing modal. Old name of `returnFocus`.

options.name: focusTrap
options.description: Enable focus trap in modal

options.name: delayHandler
options.description: Extra delay (ms) before the picker starts to close after OK, Cancel, Escape, a backdrop click or `close()`

options.name: id
options.description: Custom ID for the timepicker instance

timezone.description:
Optional timezone selector for B2B/global use cases.
This is a presentation layer only - no automatic time conversions.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable timezone selector UI

options.name: default
options.description:
Default timezone ID (e.g., 'America/New_York')
Uses browser's local timezone if not specified.

options.name: list
options.description:
Timezone IDs shown in the selector, instead of the built-in list.
If not provided, uses a curated list of common timezones.

options.name: whitelist
options.description:
Whitelist of allowed timezone IDs.
If not provided, uses a curated list of common timezones.

options.name: label
options.description: Label for timezone selector

options.name: placement
options.description:
Popover placement relative to input in compact-wheel mode.
When unset, compact-wheel opens as a modal.
Set 'auto' | 'top' | 'bottom' to show compact-wheel as a popover:
'auto' opens below if space allows, otherwise above. 'top' / 'bottom' open on that side
while it has room for at least three wheel rows, otherwise on the other side.
In every placement the popover stays inside the viewport and scrolls when it is too tall.

options.name: hideFooter
options.description:
When true, the footer (OK/Cancel/Clear buttons + switch icon)
is not rendered in the DOM at all. Only works in compact-wheel mode.
Useful when commitOnScroll is enabled and buttons are unnecessary.

options.name: commitOnScroll
options.description:
When enabled, the timepicker automatically commits the selected time
at the end of wheel scrolling, updating the input value and emitting a change event
without requiring the user to press OK. Only applies to wheel and compact-wheel modes.

options.name: hideDisabled
options.description:
When true, disabled hours/minutes/seconds are completely removed from the wheel list
instead of being dimmed. Only applies to wheel and compact-wheel modes.
Useful when many values are disabled (e.g., business hours only).

options.name: ignoreOutsideClick
options.description:
When true, clicking outside the picker area does not close it.
Only applies to wheel and compact-wheel modes (popover and modal).
The user must explicitly press OK or Cancel to close the picker.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable range mode (from-to selection)

options.name: minDuration
options.description: Minimum duration in minutes

options.name: maxDuration
options.description: Maximum duration in minutes

options.name: linked
options.description:
When false, From and To are independent: To times before From are not disabled,
the To tab is enabled from the start, and `minDuration` / `maxDuration` are not checked, so a
range may cross midnight. Use it when the host validates the range with dates.
`range:validation` still fires and reports `valid: true` once both ends are complete.
